title: Add closing key-takeaway callout to long Deep-Dive entries
reason: Large authoring sprint across 75 bilingual file pairs (150 files total). High effort relative to its M impact; best addressed as a dedicated authoring initiative rather than a sprint enhancement. Dropped as weakest P2 candidate when trimming to 20.

title: Add a Concept entry bridging AI Foundations → Deep Learning depth
reason: M impact with L effort — creating a new deep-dive group (ai-foundations-and-models) plus at least two bilingual essay pairs is a large content investment for a gap that is less acute than the missing multi-agent concept or the thin RAG group. Backlog candidate.

title: Missing Concept for 'Prompt Engineering Patterns'
reason: M impact with L effort. Creating a full advanced-prompt-engineering deep-dive is valuable but large in scope; additionally there is overlap risk with the existing chain-of-thought entry in Reasoning & Test-Time Compute. Deferred to a later content sprint.

title: Deep-Dive group header inconsistency: Safety group zh name mismatch
reason: Low impact (L). It is a data-consistency fix that should be bundled as a one-line change with any PR already touching the safety-and-security.ts file, not tracked as a standalone enhancement.

title: Add Home to all breadcrumb trails
reason: M impact but narrowly useful — most readers arriving via search already understand the site hierarchy from the URL. Crowded out by higher-value M/S/L ideas in P2 when trimming to 20.

title: BibTeX / Citation Export Block on Deep-Dive entries
reason: M impact but niche audience — the wiki's primary audience is practitioners rather than academics. Implementation is straightforward but the payoff is smaller than other M/S/L ideas retained in the final 20.

title: Add Cache-Control: immutable for content-hashed static assets
reason: M impact but purely a devops/infrastructure concern with no visible user-facing change. Vercel may already apply sensible defaults; the delta is marginal vs. the other enhancements and is best handled in a separate infrastructure pass.

title: Non-blocking Google Fonts loading to improve FCP / LCP
reason: M impact, S effort — a valid perf improvement but the delta in user-perceived performance on a mostly-static site with a CDN is small. Crowded out by higher-signal M/S/L items. Can be addressed alongside a wider font self-hosting decision.

title: Search keyboard shortcut discoverability
reason: M impact, S effort — adding a <kbd>/</kbd> badge to the search trigger is genuinely useful but less impactful than the other engagement ideas retained. Pagefind search is already functional; discoverability is a secondary concern relative to the retained items.

title: Paragraph-level share link ('Share this section')
reason: M impact, S effort — heading anchors require adding id attributes to all headings across 75+ HTML files, which is a significant authoring change. The Twitter/X intent link adds complexity. Benefit is real but incremental given the other improvements in the final 20.

title: Richer site footer with section navigation and 'New this week'
reason: M impact, S effort — a fuller footer is a nice polish item but crowded out by items with clearer reader value. The RSS feed (rank 3) already covers the 'subscribe to updates' use case, and the site nav in the header serves wayfinding. Backlog candidate after higher-priority items ship.
